data.description: The core engine should have the game launcher and should be able to be bundled with any number of the example games. Each individual example game will move to its own GitHub repo which will be checked out when building a distribution of the core engine (a distribution is the engine plus 1..n games). When developing a game individually it will work the other way around the game project will pull in the Core Engine, that is the game repo's will be a Tableau Card Engine distribution with 1 game.
data.title: REFACTOR: break out core engine and individual games into their own projects.
